description: Tên hiển thị chính của công ty QLQ
Tên viết tắt của công ty QLQ
Trạng thái hoạt động của công ty QLQ (tên trạng thái)
etl_logic: LEFT JOIN cl_fms_status ON cl_fms_status.cl_fms_status_id = fund_management_company.cl_fms_status_id → cl_fms_status.cl_fms_status_nm

description: Họ tên người đại diện theo pháp luật của công ty QLQ — nhân sự TL_PROFILES có ISR = 1, nối bằng "; " nếu có nhiều người (BA SQL: LISTAGG(tp.ITEM_NAME, "; "))
etl_logic: (SELECT STRING_AGG(fmc_employee.fmc_employee_full_nm, '; ' ORDER BY fmc_employee.fmc_employee_full_nm) FROM fmc_employee WHERE fmc_employee.fmc_id = fund_management_company.fmc_id AND fmc_employee.src_stm_code = 'FMS_TL_PROFILES' AND fmc_employee.held_share_percentage = 1)
source_attribute: Fund Management Company Employee Full Name / Held Share Percentage / Fund Management Company Id

description: Số lượng quỹ đầu tư do công ty này quản lý, hiệu lực tại kỳ
etl_logic: (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM investment_fund WHERE investment_fund.fmc_id = fund_management_company.fmc_id AND investment_fund.src_stm_code = 'FMS_FUNDS')

description: Xếp loại của công ty QLQ tại kỳ đánh giá gần nhất (1=A, 2=B, 3=C, 4=D)
etl_logic: LEFT JOIN (SELECT member_rating.fmc_id, member_rating.rating_period_tp_code AS rating_class_code, member_rating.total_score_amt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_rating.fmc_id ORDER BY CASE member_rating_period.rating_period_tp_code WHEN '1' THEN MAKE_DATE(member_rating_period.rpt_year, 6, 30) ELSE MAKE_DATE(member_rating_period.rpt_year, 12, 31) END DESC, member_rating_period.rating_finalized_flag DESC, member_rating.total_score_amt DESC) AS rn FROM member_rating INNER JOIN member_rating_period ON member_rating_period.member_rating_period_code = member_rating.member_rating_period_code WHERE CASE member_rating_period.rating_period_tp_code WHEN '1' THEN MAKE_DATE(member_rating_period.rpt_year, 6, 30) ELSE MAKE_DATE(member_rating_period.rpt_year, 12, 31) END <= :etl_date) latest_rating ON latest_rating.fmc_id = fund_management_company.fmc_id AND latest_rating.rn = 1 → member_rating.rating_period_tp_code

description: Tổng điểm CAMEL tại kỳ xếp hạng gần nhất tính đến kỳ chạy ETL
etl_logic: LEFT JOIN (SELECT member_rating.fmc_id, member_rating.rating_period_tp_code AS rating_class_code, member_rating.total_score_amt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_rating.fmc_id ORDER BY CASE member_rating_period.rating_period_tp_code WHEN '1' THEN MAKE_DATE(member_rating_period.rpt_year, 6, 30) ELSE MAKE_DATE(member_rating_period.rpt_year, 12, 31) END DESC, member_rating_period.rating_finalized_flag DESC, member_rating.total_score_amt DESC) AS rn FROM member_rating INNER JOIN member_rating_period ON member_rating_period.member_rating_period_code = member_rating.member_rating_period_code WHERE CASE member_rating_period.rating_period_tp_code WHEN '1' THEN MAKE_DATE(member_rating_period.rpt_year, 6, 30) ELSE MAKE_DATE(member_rating_period.rpt_year, 12, 31) END <= :etl_date) latest_rating ON latest_rating.fmc_id = fund_management_company.fmc_id AND latest_rating.rn = 1 → member_rating.total_score_amt
